title: Eventual equations on diagonal and triple overlap test charts
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R a diagram of Noetherian commutative rings, c an affine limit cone of Spec(R), and f:X_i→Spec(R_i) a quasi-compact quasi-separated locally finitely presented morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-base-change]. Fix j≥i, a finite affine open cover U of X_j, and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules N_a on its charts [pqf-def-coherent]. Suppose k≥j and natural overlap transitions T on U pulled back to X_k [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions] have components isomorphic to the pullbacks of N_a, and the limit pullback of T is coherent. There is l≥k where the prescribed canonical refinement pullback T′ has identity transitions on the diagonal test of every chart, and satisfies the composition equation on the universal threefold overlap of every triple of charts. The conclusion supplies chosen pairwise pullbacks sq and compatible chosen threefold pullbacks sq₃ on the refined cover. It asserts only the equations on these finitely many universal tests, and asserts no comparison to any module on the limit.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof (Zariski gluing), and clause (3); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZR

proof.text: For each cover chart apply persistent eventual diagonal equality. For each triple of cover charts apply persistent eventual composition equality. Choose the associated stages by classical choice.

The cover index type and its triple product are finite. Bound the finite union of all chosen stages and k by directedness. The two persistent conclusions then hold at this common stage. Inclusion of k makes the construction work also when the cover is empty.

Construct sq from categorical pullbacks of the two cover maps. Construct sq₃ from the pullback of sq(a,b).p₂ and sq(b,d).p₁, lifting the outer projections to sq(a,d) by the universal property. Apply the single-test conclusions for all charts and triples to these choices and combine the equations.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_overlap_eventual_chart_equations
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    [Finite U.I₀] [∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)]
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules)
    (hN : ∀ a, (N a).IsFinitePresentation) (hNq : ∀ a, (N a).IsQuasicoherent)
    :
    ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let q₀ := overlapStageMap R f hij hjk
      let V₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
        U.pullback₁ q₀
      let p₀ := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)
      ∀ T : modulesPseudofunctor.OverlapTransitions V₀.f,
        (∀ a, Nonempty ((T.obj a : (V₀.X a).Modules) ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj (N a))) →
        (T.pull (p := p₀) (α := fun a ↦ a)
          (fun a ↦ V₀.pullbackHom_map p₀ a)).Coherent →
        ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l),
          let q := overlapStageMap R f hij (hjk.trans hkl)
          let V : (pullback f (Spec.map
              (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkl)))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
            U.pullback₁ q
          let r := overlapStageMap R f (hij.trans hjk) hkl
          let s := overlapRefinementHom U q₀ q r
            (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkl)
          let T' := T.pull (p := r) (α := fun a ↦ a) (p' := s)
            (fun a ↦ overlapRefinementHom_map U q₀ q r
              (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkl) a)
          ∃ sq : ∀ a b, ChosenPullback (V.f a) (V.f b),
          ∃ sq₃ : ∀ a b d, ChosenPullback₃ (sq a b) (sq b d) (sq a d),
            (∀ a, T'.hom (V.f a) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _) (Category.id_comp _) = 𝟙 _) ∧
            (∀ a b d,
              T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₁ (sq₃ a b d).p₂
                (sq₃ a b d).w₁ (sq₃ a b d).w₂ ≫
              T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₂ (sq₃ a b d).p₃
                (sq₃ a b d).w₂ (sq₃ a b d).w₃ =
              T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₁ (sq₃ a b d).p₃
                (sq₃ a b d).w₁ (sq₃ a b d).w₃)
